issues.text: pg_dump --no-acl restores no GRANT, so the restored copy B of REQ-120 c3 could not serve the smoke. Recommended: app/db/grants.sql applied by migrate.js on every run after the files (design 4.2.4; adds two files to the lists of REQ-115/REQ-120 and the test MG-6); alternative: drop --no-acl from the flags (a REQ-120 text change). Proposal: a record decisions/NNNN-m2auth-code-design-conventions.md.
No zod (not a dependency today, F3): own strict validator app/server/http/schema.js; ARCH §3 diverges by a Plan amendment row. Recommended: yes.

Tables password_resets and login_delays beyond ARCH §4, the users columns of 4.2.1, auth_sessions without idle_expires_at (idle read from last_seen_at so a GET changes one column, REQ-114 c4). Recommended: yes, a Plan amendment row.
uat-login.js on Windows refuses (fail closed) instead of skipping the mode check. Recommended: refuse.
Pages by .html names (/setup.html, /login.html, /reset.html, /admin-totp.html); vercel.json and VC-1 unchanged; post-deploy steps say /setup.html. Recommended: yes.
The four pages need no WF-04 look description and no G21 now (functional forms on existing styles). Recommended: yes; G21 for client-facing pages with REQ-116/117.
Vercel client address from x-forwarded-for when it is exactly one IP literal, else the shared bucket unknown; post-deploy probe of design §14. Recommended: yes.
The admin delay applies only when the target account is the platform admin (the letter of REQ-114 c5). Recommended: yes.

The Neon owner role's BYPASSRLS is unread (F16): without it pg_dump refuses forced-RLS tables and db-verify refuses. Recommended: add it to spike S3 before the first dump; the runbook names the refusal.
Reset-use limit 10 per 15 minutes per address (the block names none). Recommended: yes.

Audit rows of tenant actions (REQ-117) must commit with the action, but a tenant transaction cannot read prev_hash. Recommended: name it as a question of the REQ-117 design (platform transaction with explicit org filter, or a SECURITY DEFINER append).
A wrong current password at POST /api/auth/password counts as a re-auth failure (users.reauth_* change; password_hash and sessions unchanged as REQ-114 c3 says). Recommended: yes.
Re-auth tokens are issued to ordinary users too (no route of theirs consumes one). Recommended: yes.
The rehearsal job binds ports 5433 and 18080 on the GitHub runner only. Recommended: yes.
Lane-a P1 (where the mask list of REQ-115 c8 lives) is settled in design C12 and 4.13; lane-b P1 («every other table of A») in C13 and 6.1. No block edit is needed.

Proposed anti-patterns for DOC-UPDATER (Q13): a transaction opened by exec('begin') on a shared single-connection database lets another request's statement run inside it (F9); a logical dump without ACLs restores a database the app role cannot read unless the runner re-applies the grants.
